title: Promote the TypeScript control plane to main and official
description:
## Intent
Make main carry the TypeScript control plane (develop) safely and officially, then bring staging and production onto it. Plan: docs/PROMOTE_TO_MAIN.md (PR 534 of AnthusAI/Chatticus, branch ts/promote-to-main-plan; nothing in it has been executed).

## Principle
Separate (a) main carrying the TypeScript code, (b) cutting a release, (c) deploying staging and production. The merge is boring and safe; cutover is a later, human-gated project (see chatticus-89a222: production is a separate deploy of a staging-proven release).

## Related existing tickets
chatticus-d6997c, chatticus-7ebd57, chatticus-52d238, chatticus-80b17c, chatticus-8912d6, chatticus-574e4b, chatticus-89a222.

## Definition of done
main contains the TypeScript tree with a v0.44.0 release, no accidental deploy started, the website unbroken, staging then production bootstrapped and migrated by a human-run, reviewed process. NOT started: the owner has not yet answered decisions D1 to D9.

comments.text: Progress 2026-10-14: baseline tag v0.43.1 pushed (chatticus-859e80); main branch protection applied and environments staging and production protected with reviewer endymion and branch policy main only (chatticus-5380d0). Staging and production AWS bootstrap is held until the owner says go.

right_now_summary: The team awaits owner decisions before merging TypeScript into main or starting deployments.
